testCases.input: I lost my job and got kicked out of my house because I could not pay rent. I am from Poland. I have been homeless for a couple of days, and need to shower and do laundry.
testCases.actualOutput:
Hello, I am Aidly, the HIA chatbot. I'm sorry to hear about your situation.

Since you are from Poland and currently homeless, you may need to seek emergency shelter that provides essential facilities such as showers and laundry. Crisis emergency shelters typically offer hygiene goods, shower gel, shampoo, and access to washing machines with detergent. They also provide beds, clothes, meals, and medical care.

I recommend you contact local municipal shelters or organizations that provide crisis emergency shelter services. If you are in the Netherlands or planning to come here, you can visit the municipality office to apply for shelter and temporary protection. Shelters usually have facilities for showering and laundry.

If you need help finding shelter or support, please let me know your current location or country, and I can try to guide you further.

Document: What facilities should be available at a Crisis Emergency Shelter?

The following facilities must be present at a crisis emergency shelter: - Goods hygiene - Beds, mattresses, pillows, blankets, etc. - Marker materials, potester materials, printer, markers - Wifi (very strong network for residents) - Plenty of charging stations phones residents - Recreational activities - Clothes (seasonal) young and old - Cleaning supplies - Meals (or dining money) -

Access to medical care - Third party insurance  Based on Red Cross standards, the following are specifically added: - Clothing and shoes - Shower gel - Shampoo - Toothbrush & toothpaste - Menstural hygiene - Razor - Bath Towel - Hairbrush - Diapers - Space for children  For more information see:  - https://vng.nl/sites/default/files/2021-10/handreiking-crisisnoodopvang.pdf - https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0017959/2022-01-01#HoofdstukIV

Document: You can use this to access online government services.   

For a step by step guide of what you should do if you have Temporary Protection, see: https://www.refugeehelp.nl/en/ukrainian-refugee/article/100040-this-is-what-you-should-do-if-you-have-temporary-protection  Please note: if you are staying in a municipal shelter, the municipality will contact you.

If you stay with people and want to register at this municipality, you need to register yourself.

In most cities this can be done at the city hall, but please check the website of your municpality.

Document: Do I have to pay for shelter if I have an income?

Starting July 1st 2024, displaced people from Ukraine with a job or their own income must help pay for their reception in a municipality.

You will no longer receive a living allowance.   

Displaced people from Ukraine who have to pay:   -are 18 years old and above.

-are staying in a municipal shelter.    

And who:  -have a job; or -have unemployment benefits; or -have benefits because they are long-term sick or unable to work;  -or receive an allowance.   

Check the exact amount and rules on [RefugeeHelp](https://www.refugeehelp.nl/nl/ukrainian-refugee/article/100051-leefgeld-en-eigen-financiele-bijdrage-aan-de-opvang-als-je-gevlucht-bent-uit-oekraine)

Document: General Info and Basic Instructions for TP & shelter Links to the Red Cross Website  On the Red Cross Website you can now find updated information regarding the shelter process for Ukrainian refugees.

Click on the following links for the [English](https://www.rodekruis.nl/english-information/), [Ukrainian](https://www.rodekruis.nl/ukrainian/) and the [Russian](https://www.rodekruis.nl/russian/) version of this webpage.

You can always share these links with the PA as well.

See also below what the general explanation is.   

General Information  TP is valid until March 2027.

In principle, this means that displaced people from Ukraine should be helped during this time.

However, the housing situation is difficult, especially within municipal shelters.

Therefore:  1.

If PA does not need help with shelter, and can afford a place to stay (even for a few days): PA can look for a place themselves.

PA has to check if they can register at the accommodation and also at the municipality.  

2.

If PA needs help with finding shelter, please know that the situation is currently very difficult and becoming more restricted.   

3.

Document: What facilities should be available at an Emergency Shelter?

The following facilities must be present at a crisis emergency shelter: - Goods hygiene - Beds, mattresses, pillows, blankets, etc. - Marker materials, potester materials, printer, markers - Wifi (very strong network for residents) - Plenty of charging stations phones residents - Recreational activities - Clothes (seasonal) young and old - Cleaning supplies - Meals (or dining money) -

Document: Tips for Applying for Temporary Protection (Email, WhatsApp)

Please ask the  PAs to write a formal request to the municipality.  

Please do not just "I need help".

Please write and  explain that :   - This is Application for Temporary Protection, -

In need fo accommodation, (if applicable, include where you are staying currently and how long you can stay there) - Full Name, - Date of Birth, -

Date you left Ukraine ( to the EU or to NL), - Ukrainian documents ( photo of passport in attachement),  - Details of each person requesting help, including family relations, - Special needs, if applicable (e.g. medical conditions, senior citizens, unaccompanied minor..)

- Offer to provide more infromation if request by the municipality

Document: How can I get support with clothes?  

The Red Cross Helpful Information website provides an overview of clothing options available in different cities.

You can always refer the PA to this website or share the list of options found there directly.  

https://helpfulinformation.redcross.nl/  For most recent information on initiatives that provide support in clothes or offer clothes for a small price see: https://www.refugeehelp.nl/en/marketplace

Document: Can I rent a house?  

You can rent a house from private individuals.

In general, houses are expensive, because there is a large housing shortage in the Netherlands, especially in the larger cities.   

As a displaced person from Ukraine, you will receive living allowance when you stay at a shelter location, both in the municipal shelter and in the private shelter.

If you rent your own independent accommodation, you are no longer entitled to living allowance.  

Places where private homes are offered: Funda, AirBNB, Marktplaats website, Facebook groups per city (search for 'I'm looking for a home').   

For most recent information see: [RefugeeHelp](https://www.refugeehelp.nl/en/ukrainian-refugee/article/100045-permanent-housing)  and [renting a house](https://www.refugeehelp.nl/en/ukrainian-refugee/article/100047-this-is-what-you-need-to-arrange-if-you-rent-a-house)

Document: Can I stay in the public shelter while I have a paid job?  

Displaced persons from Ukraine that are doing paid work may remain at the municipal reception centre.

However, you will have to pay a contribution.

You can also move to other accommodation, for instance with a host family, friends or family members, or at a hotel.  

For most recent information see: https://www.government.nl/topics/reception-of-refugees-from-ukraine/work-and-income

Document: What can I do when I am evicted or transferred from the shelter?

If the PA is entitled to a place at a municipal reception centre but was evicted or transferred to another shelter, collect information about the case.

How long did the PA stay there?

What was the reason for eviction?

Discuss the case with the Team Captain and forward PA also to the online consultation of RefugeeHelp: https://www.refugeehelp.nl/nl/ukrainian-refugee/appointment

Document: How can I get financial support while I'm in a public shelter?

You get your living allowance from the municipality where you are registered.

You receive the money in their bank account, on a money card, in cash or in goods.  

Living allowance may be payed out in kind by local authorities (for example when meals are offered).

As a result, it is possible that displaced persons in some municipalities receive (much) less living allowance.   

For most recent information see:  https://www.government.nl/topics/reception-of-refugees-from-ukraine/work-and-income

Document: Where can I find shelter when arriving in the Netherlands?  

Links to the Red Cross Website  On the Red Cross Website you can now find updated information regarding the shelter process for Ukrainian refugees.

Click on the following links for the [English](https://www.rodekruis.nl/english-information/), [Ukrainian](https://www.rodekruis.nl/ukrainian/) and the [Russian](https://www.rodekruis.nl/russian/) version of this webpage.

You can always share these links with the PA as well.

See also below what the general explanation is.   

General advice  If you want to apply for Temporary Protection and need help with a shelter place, visit a municipality ("gemeente" in Dutch).

Municipalities register displaced Ukrainians and help find housing.

(Please check the latest Temporary Protection rules on [RefugeeHelp](https://www.refugeehelp.nl/ru/ukrainian-refugee/article/100187-chtoby-poluchit-vremennuyu-zashchitu-vy-dolzhny-sootvetstvovat-etim-usloviyam).)

Document: Public shelter If you are covered by the Temporary Protection Directive, you keep your right to reception.

The reception is a joint responsibility of all Dutch municipalities and Safety Regions.

In the first place you report to the municipality in which you are registered with a request for a place in the municipal reception facilities.

If there is no room (or no longer any room), the 'registering municipality' will contact the safety region.

The safety region will see if there is a place available in the region.

If that is not the case, the safety region submits a request for trans-regional relocation to the KCIO (Ukraine Coordination Information Office).

Document: How can I get food support?  

When you are staying in a public shelter, please approach someone from the shelter to ask where you can find additional food support.

You can also contact the Red Cross Food Program Helpdesk.

For all general questions, new applications, extension requests, etc, PA's can call/text/

WhatsApp them at +31 97010259797 (Mon-Fri 9:00 – 17:00).  

In municipalities all over the country Voedselbank Nederland (Food Bank Netherlands) distributes food parcels to displaced persons from Ukraine.

Too find out if you are eligible, please see: https://voedselbankennederland.nl/vertalingen/english/
Document: List of organisations helping refugees in Ukraine and abroad https://www.phc.org.ua/news/perelik-organizaciy-scho-dopomagayut-bizhencyam-v-ukraini-ta-za-kordonom

Document: I have a complaint about the shelter.

Always check if the shelter is run by the Red Cross or not: https://helpfulinformation-faq.redcross.nl/ukraine/category-5/category-20   If it is run by the Red Cross then report this to the Team Captain and tell the person to fill in this form: https://www.rodekruis.nl/en/contact/complaints-or-suggestions/   If it is not run by the Red Cross, share the steps mentioned below with the person.   

Note: when answering to the client do not offer all 4 options at once.

For a first complaint message, you can suggest to the client only the first two options.

If afterwards you have a returning message from the client, then you can suggest to the client option number 3 and you can help find contact details of the municipality, and ask the client to write back to us again after this client receives the answer from the municipality.   

1.

First, address with situation with the management of the shelter.

Try to discuss things and find some compromise solution.  

2.

Document: Netherlands (but not Amsterdam/Utrecht/Swolgen/Heerevenveen/Rotterdam/Haarlem) General advise If you’re coming to the Netherlands with a Ukrainian passport/valid permanent Ukrainian residence permit and proof you left Ukraine after November 26, 2021, you have a right to Shelter & Temporary Protection.

To apply, visit the municipality office in the city where you will arrive.  

Please note that the housing situation here is challenging and becoming more restricted.

We recommend contacting us before you leave to get the latest updates.  

If possible, try to arrange accommodation on your own when arriving in the Netherlands.

Note that you need a local address (accommodation) to apply for temporary protection.   

Actions to take when general advise was not sufficient NO referrals for cases outside of the Netherlands.

Advise the PA to contact us upon arrival.   

Actions to take when general advise is not sufficient If the PA shares challenges in finding a place to stay, please consult with the Team Captain.

Document: I need medical treatment in the Netherlands and an I am abroad  Many people in Ukraine lack access to the medical care they need.

This can be for all kinds of diseases, like cancer treatment, but also for wounds caused by grenades, bullets or mines.   

For a detailed step-by-step guide on handling cases where PAs abroad want to come to the Netherlands, see below.  

## Important notes  - There are two main categories of people wanting to come to NL for medical treatment.

Always ask the PA about their goal of coming to the Netherlands:  1.

Coming to the Netherlands for temporary treatment and then returning to Ukraine: Since the start of the war, the EU has designed a standard procedure for Ukrainians in need of urgent medical care.

The patients must be applied by their doctor for one of the following programs: Medevac Coordination Center (Civil) or Medical Forces Command (Military).

EU countries (NL included) will receive these applications and can decide to accept the case, after which the patient will be brought to a medical hub in Poland and then transferred to the country that accepted.
